title: Verifiable Spacecraft Lifecycle: reference implementation and evaluation harness for software supply-chain assurance of spacecraft flight software
description: Source code, test suite, evaluation harness, raw results, and figure scripts for a six-level additive assurance ladder (S0 to S5) for spacecraft flight software updates, evaluated on two stand-in applications and the unmodified NASA cFS and JPL F Prime frameworks. Includes the 15-case attack matrix, ablation study, hash-only and TUF baselines, a specification-based Uptane coverage analysis, and a mutation experiment.
